business_summary: Capital City Bank Group, Inc. operates as the financial holding company for Capital City Bank that provides a range of banking services to individual and corporate clients. The company offers financing for commercial business properties, equipment, inventories, and accounts receivable, as well as commercial leasing and letters of credit; treasury management services; and merchant credit card transaction processing services. It also provides commercial and residential real estate lending products, as well as fixed and adjustable-rate residential mortgage loans; personal, automobile, boat/RV, and home equity loans. In addition, the company offers institutional banking services, including customized checking and savings accounts, cash management systems, tax-exempt loans, lines of credit, and term loans to meet the needs of state and local governments, public schools and colleges, charities, membership, and not-for-profit associations. Further, it provides consumer banking services comprising checking accounts, savings programs, interactive/automated teller machines, debit/credit cards, night deposit services, safe deposit facilities, and online and mobile banking services. Additionally, the company provides asset management for individuals through agency, personal trust, IRA, and personal investment management accounts; and various retail investment products, such as the U.S. government bonds, tax-free municipal bonds, stocks, mutual funds, unit investment trusts, annuities, life insurance, and long-term health care, as well as business, estate, financial, insurance and business planning, tax planning, and asset protection advisory services. Further, the company offers mortgage banking. Capital City Bank Group, Inc. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Tallahassee, Florida.
business_summary_ko: Capital City Bank Group, Inc.는 개인 및 기업 고객에게 다양한 금융 서비스를 제공하는 Capital City Bank의 금융 지주 회사로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 상업용 비즈니스 자산, 장비, 재고, 미수금 계정, 상업용 임대 및 신용장에 대한 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 재무 관리 서비스; 및 가맹점 신용카드 거래 처리 서비스. 또한 상업용 및 주거용 부동산 대출 상품은 물론 고정 금리 및 조정 금리 주택 모기지 대출도 제공합니다. 개인, 자동차, 보트/RV, 주택 담보 대출. 또한 회사는 주 및 지방 정부, 공립 학교 및 대학, 자선 단체, 회원 및 비영리 협회의 요구 사항을 충족하기 위해 맞춤형 당좌 예금 및 저축 계좌, 현금 관리 시스템, 면세 대출, 신용 한도 및 정기 대출을 포함한 기관 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 당좌예금 계좌, 저축 프로그램, 대화형/자동 입출금기, 직불/신용 카드, 야간 예금 서비스, 안전 예금 시설, 온라인 및 모바일 뱅킹 서비스로 구성된 소비자 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 추가의
